visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a young baby girl with short dark bangs and a green and white striped shirt. She is crawling on a light-colored wooden floor in a hallway. Her facial expression is one of pure joy, with a wide smile and squinted eyes as she moves toward the camera. (2) The camera angle widens to reveal the baby lying flat on her stomach next to an orange and white tabby cat that is also lying down. An adult's hands enter the frame, alternating between patting the baby's back and the cat's back in a rapid, rhythmic motion. (3) The scene transitions to a side view where the baby and the cat are side-by-side. The cat looks curiously at the camera with wide eyes while the baby rests her chin on her hands. In the background, household items like a printer and storage bins are visible. (4) The orange cat suddenly stands up and walks away toward the right, leaving the baby alone on the floor. The baby remains in a prone position, looking directly into the lens with a calm and observant expression. (5) A hand continues to pat the baby's lower back. The baby responds by pushing her chest off the floor and looking back toward the person behind her, her hair appearing slightly disheveled from the activity on the floor. (6) The baby finally sits up completely on the wooden floor, leaning back slightly. She has a bright, giggling expression on her face as she looks toward the adult. The lighting is bright and even throughout the indoor setting. (7) The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring a centered cartoon illustration of the baby girl sitting and waving, with stylized white text appearing beneath the graphic.
